## Execution kickoff

The serialized plan review returned a signed PASS at `ae4030bd4a920762e27971f59a7aafdc4fcc0026`. F18 was claimed without an explicit assignee before documentation edits or verification commands.

The P6 advisory identified the criterion that requires the documentation index and focused user-guide checks to pass. I am retaining that criterion because D1 and D2 already verify the two named checks independently. The conjunction does not merge their evidence or make either result subjective.

The first review attempt failed before model execution with the remote-tracking ref comparison recorded on `agrologic-oval-bobolink`. A serialized fetch and review completed successfully. The complete error and control result were appended to that bug. No duplicate bug was created.
